title: Case 004: Why the transfer was declined
initial_request: I am the account holder and made a transfer to Northmere Housing Co-operative on 14 July 2025. The secure portal says it was not completed, but I cannot see why. Please explain the reason.
overview: Mara Ellery asked H&V to explain why her transfer to Northmere Housing Co-operative was marked “Not completed” in the secure portal. The agent checked the transaction journal and used its permitted customer-facing wording to explain that the receiving bank declined the transfer. No new transfer was made.

next_action.summary: Check the transaction journal for the decline code on Mara Ellery’s transfer and confirm the wording H&V is permitted to share.

outcome: The secure portal now explains that the receiving bank declined the transfer. No new transfer was made.

events.body: Transfer to Northmere Housing Co-operative — status: “Not completed”.
I am the account holder and this was my transfer. Please tell me why it was not completed; the portal shows the status but no reason.
I am checking the decline code for Mara Ellery’s transfer to Northmere Housing Co-operative dated 14 July 2025. Please return the code and the customer-facing wording permitted for this transaction.
I found a decline code recorded for this transfer. The permitted customer-facing wording is: “The receiving bank declined the transfer.”
I checked the transfer record. The receiving bank declined the transfer, so H&V did not complete it. No new transfer has been made.
